question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**capable.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Blank 2 in the given passage should explain the ability or qualities of the kangaroos.**
 
• Among the given options:
 
 
• **The correct word to use in the blank is "capable."**
 
• "Capable" means having the ability or qualities necessary to do something.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be:
 
 
• The man-sized kangaroos of Australia are capable__ of speeding up to 88 km/h for short distances.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
